about: The Open Loops vocabulary (OpenSpec change open-loops-method, design D1): one id per term, the English name and description. The app translates them through the catalogs (scripts/i18n/extract.mjs reads this file); the site bundle writes them, translated, to method.json. Ids are added, never renamed or reused.
name: Open Loops
tagline: Everything that has your attention gets a home.

moves.name: Catch
moves.description: Get whatever is on your mind into the Inbox the moment it appears.

moves.name: Clarify
moves.description: Decide once what each item is and what it needs.

moves.name: Place
moves.description: Give every item one home: a project, a date, Waiting or Someday.

moves.name: Do
moves.description: Work from your next actions, by context, one step at a time.

moves.name: Review
moves.description: Look over the whole system on a rhythm, so you can trust it.

principles.name: Catch everything
principles.description: If it is on your mind, it goes in the Inbox.

principles.name: Decide once
principles.description: Each item gets one decision, the first time you look at it.

principles.name: Do it if it is quicker than filing it
principles.description: A task of a minute or two is done on the spot, not filed.

principles.name: One next step
principles.description: Every project always shows its very next action.

principles.name: Hide what is not now
principles.description: Deferred, waiting and someday items stay out of sight until they matter.

principles.name: Review on a rhythm
principles.description: A system works only while you trust it, and you trust it by reviewing it.

principles.name: Your loops, your server
principles.description: Everything stays on your devices and your own server, private by design.

places.name: Next
places.description: The next action of every project, by context.

places.name: Waiting
places.description: Waits for someone or something else first.

places.name: Scheduled
places.description: Has a day: Today and Upcoming.

places.name: Someday
places.description: Maybe one day: parked without a date.

places.name: Projects
places.description: Outcomes that take more than one step.

rhythms.name: Daily check
rhythms.description: Five minutes: the Inbox to zero, what is open from earlier, and today's focus.

rhythms.name: Weekly review
rhythms.description: Thirty minutes: get clear, get current, get creative.

rhythms.name: Monthly look
rhythms.description: Twenty minutes: your areas, old someday items and the four-week trend.

horizons.name: Area
horizons.description: A part of life you keep up, made of projects.
